policy.description: BEFORE = CURRENT - 2.0s, AFTER = CURRENT + 2.0s, clamped to [0, source_duration], fixed for all 13 cases -- no per-case tuning
policy.clamp_note: 10/13 cases (all sourced from the 15 Agustos fallback-derived 125-frame clips) have CURRENT at t=1.24s, so BEFORE clamps to t=0.0 -- actual before-delta is only 1.24s, not the full 2.0s. Only 3 cases (all Elenora-sourced, longer clips) got the full +/-2.0s window.

hard_negative_preservation: PRESERVED -- 0 false positives in both single-frame and temporal modes across all 9 negative samples, including the cake_visible_vs_cake_cutting pair (33 vs 39) and ordinary-dancing-vs-first-dance pairs (22, 29, 24, 26, 32, 36, 30 vs 40)
verdict: Temporal BEFORE/CURRENT/AFTER context provided ZERO measured incremental value over single-frame on this 13-case corpus -- identical classification on every single case (0 transitions in either direction) -- while costing meaningfully more latency (44% median, up to 347% at P90) due to 3x image tokens per inference.
